description:
Search SIIL clothing by keyword, category, language/country, or price range.

    Args:
        query: Search keywords in EN/ES/FR/DE or EU languages (matches product name, SKU, family).
               Examples: "ostomy belt", "stoma belt uk", "stomagürtel", "ceinture stomie", "ostomy wraps", "MB01720"
        category: Filter by English name or live Woo slug.
                  Aliases: swimwear=banoen, belts=cinturon-siil-en,
                  underwear=intimo-en, panties=panties, wraps=bandas-en,
                  lingerie=bodies-en, protector=siil-protector-en, accessories
        min_price: Minimum price in EUR (e.g. 30.0)
        max_price: Maximum price in EUR (e.g. 100.0)
        limit: Number of results (max 50, default 20)
        lang: Optional locale code (en, en-gb, de, fr, es, or .org: it, nl, pl, sv, da, nb, fi, cs, sk, hu, ro, el, pt, ja)
        country: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (US, GB, DE, FR, ES, NL, IT, PL, SE...)
name: search_products
